description: This file implements a Prometheus metrics reporter for gRPC middleware, defining classes and methods for collecting and exposing metrics related to gRPC calls, including server and client metrics, and handling metrics reporting with context labels and exemplars.

classes.name: reporter
classes.description: A struct for handling gRPC metrics reporting, including metrics counters, histograms, and context labels.

classes.name: reportable
classes.description: A struct providing server and client reporter methods for metrics collection.

methods.name: PostCall
methods.description: Records metrics after a gRPC call completes, based on call type and status.

methods.name: PostMsgSend
methods.description: Records metrics after a message is sent in a gRPC stream.

methods.name: PostMsgReceive
methods.description: Records metrics after a message is received in a gRPC stream.

methods.name: ServerReporter
methods.description: Creates a server-side reporter for metrics collection.

methods.name: ClientReporter
methods.description: Creates a client-side reporter for metrics collection.

methods.name: reporter
methods.description: Initializes a reporter instance with context, metrics, and labels.

methods.name: incrementWithExemplar
methods.description: Increments a Prometheus counter with an associated exemplar.

methods.name: observeWithExemplar
methods.description: Records an observation in a Prometheus histogram with an associated exemplar.
